description: F7 part 2 golden, rule 12: FillHazardModel.features / bucket_hazards / p_fill_within over a grid of feature rows under many models (`models`: the part-1 fixture, the wave-5 fit that diverged by 1 ulp, dense cloglog / logit models, an eta-clipping model, six seeded coefficient sets). The Python reference evaluates scalar and left-to-right (fill_hazard._row_hazards, #200), the order of cpp/src/execution/fill_hazard.cpp; byte parity on every row.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`
